description: This file defines Kubernetes API types related to server configuration, including admission control, egress selection, tracing, authentication, and authorization configurations, with detailed structures and constants for each component.

classes.name: AdmissionConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration for admission controllers, including plugin configurations.

classes.name: AdmissionPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration for individual admission plugins.

classes.name: EgressSelectorConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration for egress selector clients.

classes.name: EgressSelection
classes.description: Configuration for a single egress selection client.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Configuration for connection details to egress clients.

classes.name: Transport
classes.description: Transport configurations for connecting to konnectivity server.

classes.name: TCPTransport
classes.description: TCP connection details for konnectivity server.

classes.name: UDSTransport
classes.description: Unix domain socket connection details for konnectivity server.

classes.name: TLSConfig
classes.description: TLS authentication configuration for TCP transport.

classes.name: TracingConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration for tracing clients.

classes.name: AuthenticationConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration for authentication mechanisms including JWT and anonymous auth.

classes.name: AnonymousAuthConfig
classes.description: Configuration for anonymous authentication.

classes.name: AnonymousAuthCondition
classes.description: Conditions under which anonymous auth is enabled.

classes.name: JWTAuthenticator
classes.description: Configuration for a JWT authenticator.

classes.name: Issuer
classes.description: Configuration for external issuer settings for JWT.

classes.name: ClaimValidationRule
classes.description: Rules for validating claims in JWT.

classes.name: ClaimMappings
classes.description: Mapping rules for claims.

classes.name: PrefixedClaimOrExpression
classes.description: Configuration for claim or expression with optional prefix.

classes.name: ClaimOrExpression
classes.description: Single claim or expression configuration.

classes.name: ExtraMapping
classes.description: Additional claim mapping.

classes.name: UserValidationRule
classes.description: Rules for validating user info.

classes.name: AuthorizationConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration for authorization policies.

classes.name: AuthorizerConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration for individual authorizers, including webhooks.

classes.name: WebhookConfiguration
classes.description: Webhook authorization cache and timeout settings.

classes.name: WebhookConnectionInfo
classes.description: Connection details for webhook communication.

classes.name: WebhookMatchCondition
classes.description: Conditions for triggering webhooks based on CEL expressions.
